title: Stuck at 0.947 after ten board tests. What I measured, and one question about the relink stage
author: Justin CH123 (now LB 0.956, #130, 70 subs); comments by OmerZalman (0.957), OpPrime (0.953), Civitasmass (0.953), Gourav Roy (team Rishabh Roy 0.957), You WeiLin, nusrati
what_it_says: Justin: 10 single-knob changes on the public 0.947 stack all lost; LB loss tracked the change in predicted node count, not offline edge J; final edges come from the Hungarian relink. On 23 Sep he wrote he had NOT retrained the detector, only post-processing, and that his division J ~0.23 is where he thinks the gap is. He then went 0.953 (x138 copy, 24 Sep) -> 0.956 (by 25 Sep 19:46Z), i.e. +0.003 over x138 most likely from post-processing/division work alone. OmerZalman (0.957): 'you have to improve all parts', echoed by a 0.969 player. Civitasmass: retrained detector, but not all of his LB gain came from the retrain; check that local gains are spread across videos, not 1-2 outliers. OpPrime: division links are lost at every stage (pre-ILP, ILP, relink/validation). NEW today: nusrati asks Justin how he got the jump - unanswered.
actionable_for_us: Watch this thread for Justin's answer (only concrete public trace of a 0.953->0.956 PP-only jump). Supports continuing division-side post-processing on x138 (our DaughterNet insertion line) rather than knob sweeps; apply Civitasmass's per-video spread check to any candidate before a probe.

title: Eight leaderboard experiments on the public 0.947 stack - all negative, here are the numbers
author: imissher (LB 0.947)
what_it_says: Paired LB results on the dual-seed 0.947 stack: relink off 0.946 (local +0.017), ILP candidate threshold 0.48->0.30 LB 0.000 (local +0.009), Z-flip TTA 8->16 views 0.946, det threshold 0.960 0.946 and 0.970 0.945 (0.965 is the optimum), secondary det weight 0.80->0.65 0.945, own model in secondary slot 0.939, secondary adapted 6 h at lr 1e-5 on 600 synthetic + 40 real videos 0.939. Changes that trust the learned association more failed; geometric repair helped. Trap: the in-kernel validator excludes train stems present in TEST_DIR, so the hidden rerun scores a different 8 videos and can pick a different PP config than the commit log shows. Training cost: 2xT4, 64^3 windows, batch 16 OOM, 12-14 s/step, 35-40 min/epoch.
actionable_for_us: Negative list to avoid in the last 2 days: do not move det threshold, do not add Z-flip TTA, do not change secondary det weight, do not lower the ILP candidate threshold or disable relink. Validator trap does NOT hit us: x138 sets BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0 (checked experiments/exp56_x138_verbatim). A naive secondary swap / synthetic adaptation lost 0.006-0.009, so any retrained secondary needs the teacher-anchored recipe (cf. y3uanm), not a plain fine-tune.

title: Model changes don't move the LB above the public plateau - what actually did for you?
author: hikaggler (now LB 0.957, #104); Ogurtsov (VOXEL ART 0.968); TWEAK (0.961); MOHAMMADJAFAR ZAMANI (0.955)
what_it_says: hikaggler (own pipeline was 0.939 on 18 Sep, now 0.957): deeper UNet, longer training, heatmap losses, wider temporal window, a division head (local divJ 0.07->0.19) all ~0 on LB; only levers were synthetic pretraining (497 of 2,174 sequences, +0.012 on hold-out, pushes node count up) and CONDITIONAL two-model fusion, using the second model 'only on columns where the primary is uncertain'. Node-count calibration predicts LB best; locally chosen PP settings carry over, local ranking of trained weights does not (r ~ -0.2). Ogurtsov: 0.947->0.957 reachable from the published UNet only partly, and risky for the private LB.
actionable_for_us: Candidate 2-day inference-only idea: uncertainty-gated fusion (replace/augment x138's fixed 0.2/0.8 blend only where the primary is uncertain) with a model we already have (e.g. our fine-tuned primary). Needs one LB probe and cannot be trusted locally; hikaggler's jump 0.939->0.957 suggests he combined his models with the x138 stack.
